airdrops.about: What is Monetrix? Monetrix is a yield-bearing stablecoin protocol built natively on HyperEVM . The protocol issues USDM, a stablecoin pegged 1:1 to USDC, and sUSDM, its auto-compounding staked version. Yield comes from delta-neutral strategies that captures funding rates, HLP returns, maker rebates, and other Hyperliquid-native sources without any centralized exchange custody or off-chain execution. Every position is verifiable on-chain, which is the main differentiator against yield-bearing stablecoins that rely on opaque CEX-based strategies. Monetrix is built by the Hybra team and was audited through a Code4rena contest in April 2026. Funding details have not been publicly disclosed. The protocol is currently in its pre-launch phase, with the Genesis Signal campaign live ahead of the main Genesis opening.

airdrops.about: What is Raiku? Raiku is a Solana infrastructure platform designed to bring enterprise-grade certainty to blockchain operations. The project addresses one of the most persistent challenges in blockchain technology: the unpredictability of blockspace. By establishing a fair and efficient market for blockspace, Raiku transforms it from an unpredictable commodity into a guaranteed, programmable resource that businesses can rely on. The platform serves multiple stakeholders in the Solana ecosystem. Developers can build applications without worrying about infrastructure failures, while traders gain consistent and fully predictable execution. Institutions benefit from the ability to operate with certainty at scale, and validators can scale their revenue through plugins. This comprehensive approach positions Raiku as critical infrastructure for enterprises looking to build and operate on Solana efficiently.
